note: Event to alert rules (TASK-162). free rules are basic safety info and are never gated by the ladder row alerts. Text is the hero's voice; classText overrides it per class. Placeholders: {hero} {item} {quality} {monster} {area} {level} {pct} {reason} {from} {to}.

rules.text: Stay a while and listen: the hero has died to {monster} in {area}.

classText.amazon: The Amazon falls to {monster} in {area}. Her spear lies cold.
classText.sorceress: The Sorceress is spent. {monster} ended her in {area}.
classText.necromancer: The Necromancer joins his own dead, taken by {monster} in {area}.
classText.paladin: The Paladin is down. {monster} took her in {area}; the Light waits.
classText.barbarian: The Barbarian is felled by {monster} in {area}. The mountain is quiet.
classText.druid: The Druid is torn down by {monster} in {area}. The wolves howl.
classText.assassin: The Assassin is caught by {monster} in {area}. The shadows close.

rules.text: The hero is hurt badly: life is down to {pct}% in {area}.
{monster} has fallen. The hero stands over the remains.
The hero has grown stronger: level {level}.
Worn gear is getting thin: {item} (lowest {pct} percent). Press Repair now on the Inventory page when you are ready.
Gear has broken: {item}. It gives no protection until it is repaired. Press Repair now on the Inventory page.
The hero is back in {area} and ready to trade.
A Pact holds the hero in town and waits for you: {reason}
The hero would like to leave {from} for {to} and awaits your word.
